stem: A test randomly assigns 100,000 Voltmarkt users, 50/50, to the current product page or a new one. Which of these problems does the random assignment not protect against?

options.text: More engaged users ending up on the new page more often than others
The new page recording purchases less reliably than the current page
Returning customers making up a far larger share of one of the groups
Users choosing for themselves which of the two pages they want to see
